title: Exact localization identifies the intrinsic clopen comparison and its mate
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$, and $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. All schemes are finite-type $k$-schemes; their structure maps are not required to be separated [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For each $T$, choose either $\mathscr M_T=\operatorname{Mod}((A_n)_T)$ at one fixed $n$, or the category $\mathscr M_T$ of module sheaves $M_n$ over $(A_n)_T$ with semilinear maps $M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{A_{n+1}\to A_n}M_n$ and compatible componentwise morphisms [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars, lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Use the ordinary unbounded derived category $D(\mathscr M_T)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For a scheme map $f$ write $f^*$ for exact constant-coefficient module inverse image and $P_f=D(f^*)$; for an open immersion $j$ write $j_!$ for exact extension by zero and $J_j=D(j_!)$. Use the specified adjunctions $P_f\dashv S_f=Rf_*$ and $J_j\dashv P_j$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. System operations are constructed simultaneously on the ringed diagram site, before finite evaluation, scalar restriction or total limit [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections].

Let $k_1:U\hookrightarrow V$ and $i:W\hookrightarrow Z$ be quasi-compact open immersions, let $r:U\to W$ and $p:V\to Z$ be proper, and assume $pk_1=ir$. Put $V_W=V\times_ZW$, with projections $b:V_W\to V$, $q:V_W\to W$, and induced map $s=(k_1,r):U\to V_W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. No Cartesian hypothesis is imposed on this square.

Use the decomposition $V_W=s(U)\amalg C$ and projector $\pi_s:F\to s_!s^*F$ given by identity on $s(U)$ and zero on $C$. With $\widetilde\beta:p^*i_!\cong b_!q^*$ the underived open-unit-normalized base-change comparison, define
$$\widetilde a_Q:p^*i_!\xrightarrow{\widetilde\beta}b_!q^*\xrightarrow{b_!\pi_sq^*}b_!s_!s^*q^*\cong(k_1)_!r^*.$$
Here the last comparison is the adjunction-normalized open and inverse-image compositor [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction, lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. This is a natural transformation between exact functors in either abelian coefficient category. Its restriction to $U$, after the canonical open units and pullback compositors, is $1_{r^*M}$ for every $M\in\mathscr M_W$; it is the unique sheaf or system transformation with that restriction.

Termwise application to arbitrary unbounded cochain complexes and exact localization gives precisely the intrinsic derived composite
$$a_Q:P_pJ_i\xrightarrow{\beta}J_bP_q\xrightarrow{J_b\pi_sP_q}J_bJ_sP_sP_q\cong J_{k_1}P_r.$$
In particular the localized $\widetilde\beta$ is the specified open-unit-normalized $\beta$, and the localized open adjunction has the localized ordinary unit and counit. This equality holds on the simultaneous derived system category before evaluation. Under the mate bijection [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], the proper-adjunction mate is exactly
$$\Gamma_Q=S_p(J_{k_1}\varepsilon_r)\circ S_p(a_QS_r)\circ\eta_pJ_iS_r:J_iS_r\to S_pJ_{k_1}.$$
The $a_Q,\Gamma_Q$ in this formula are the specified clopen $\alpha,\gamma$ normalization in [lem-sf-proper-open-projection-mate], in both coefficient settings; this assertion concerns their normalization, not invertibility or the projection-formula identity.

proof.text: Prove the ordinary alpha restriction equation from the open beta-unit equation, the clopen projector restriction and the unit-normalized open compositor. Cancel the open source unit and use injectivity of restriction into an open extension to prove uniqueness. For systems, use moduleAlpha_restriction and module_clopen_factor_hom_ext on the whole module category. The factorized unit equation follows directly by naturality of the pullback compositor and the open unit; no étale normalization theorem is used.

proof.text: Localize the specified ordinary open adjunction termwise. Adjunction.localization_unit_app and localization_counit_app give the two equations on all QK, using the standard exact factorization isomorphisms. The ordinary total-derived open adjunction equals this exact localization; the two system presentations agree by equality of their underlying pushforwards and chosen adjunctions.

proof.text: Expand mateEquiv to obtain the unit-alpha-counit formulas. Equality of the proper adjunctions and alpha transports system gamma between the two presentations. Naturality of the mate bijection under the four canonical bridge isomorphisms, followed by cancellation of their components, gives the realization formula. Retain the resulting unit--comparison--counit equation as the public properMateFormula predicate of [def-sf-ambient-exact-clopen-data]; its body is exactly the same component equation and keeps the native category dictionaries shared.
